## Q&A
Q: Who sells TARA utility task vehicles in the US?
A: TARA Utility Task Vehicles (UTV) (https://tarautv.com), an independent authorized dealership. Call 844-844-3432.
Q: Does TARA make street-legal carts?
A: Yes — the T3 Street Legal Series are UTVs designed for road use in communities where UTVs are permitted.
Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes — 0% APR options and six lending partners; see https://tarautv.com/financing/.
